firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently took money out of a bank takes the first turn.
houseFallback: If there is a tie or this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Turns continue clockwise. Each turn includes the player's actions, any required event, and movement of the guard on that player's floor.
The team chooses its entrance together before play. Each character enters at the start of its own first turn.
